contextual_resolubility_validation.validation_summary: Three ambiguities detected in the requirement text, two lexical and one referential.

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: the glass break detector of a window
unsupported_interpretations: A device that detects broken glass is installed on the window.
The window itself has an integrated glass break sensor.
evidence_from_requirement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged
missing_information: Definition or contextual information about the 'glass break detector'
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement contains no definition or contextual information about the 'glass break detector', making it unclear whether it refers to a device or a specific type of window.

unsupported_interpretations: The entire window has been damaged.
Only the glass part of the window has been damaged.
evidence_from_requirement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged
missing_information: Definition or contextual information about the 'pane'
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement contains no definition or contextual information about the 'pane', making it unclear whether it refers to the entire window or just the glass part.

unsupported_interpretations: An internal security team will be informed.
An external security company will be contacted.
evidence_from_requirement: within 2 seconds at the latest. The system shall inform the security service
missing_information: Definition or contextual information about the 'security service'
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement contains no definition or contextual information about the 'security service', making it unclear whether an internal team or external company will be informed.

overall_resolubility.explanation: At least one ambiguity is unresolved; the case must bypass Agent 3.
